name: Recycling
highLevelGoals: The User aims to quickly and easily find nearby recycling facilities based on their location or specific search criteria.
The User seeks to view detailed information about recycling facilities, including operational hours, accepted materials, and contact details.
The User desires to be informed about upcoming recycling events, special waste drop-off sites, and other relevant community initiatives.
The User wants to personalize their experience by saving favorite facilities, tracking their recycling activities, and receiving tailored recommendations.
The User aims to easily submit feedback, ask questions, and report issues to improve the overall recycling service.
The Administrator aims to ensure that all recycling facility information displayed on the platform is current, correct, and comprehensive.
The Administrator seeks to efficiently review, categorize, and respond to user feedback, complaints, and questions to enhance user satisfaction.
The Administrator is committed to protecting all user and facility data from unauthorized access, ensuring compliance with privacy regulations.
The Administrator aims to establish and maintain clear communication channels with facility representatives to coordinate updates and address issues.
The Facility Representative aims to easily and accurately update their facility's operational hours, accepted materials, and other relevant details.
The Facility Representative seeks a direct and effective way to convey any operational issues or concerns to the site administrators for resolution.
The Superuser aims to provide the most current and accurate information about recycling centers to users by having elevated update privileges.
The Superuser seeks to efficiently answer user questions related to recycling centers, leveraging their elevated access to information.
lowLevelGoals: The User can initiate a search to find recycling facilities within a specified radius of their current location.
The User can input a location to find recycling facilities relevant to that area.
The User can refine their search to only show facilities that accept specific materials (e.g., plastic, paper, glass).
The User can click on a facility from the search results to see all its specific information.
The User can see the opening and closing times for a chosen facility.
The User can view a comprehensive list of materials that a selected facility accepts for recycling.
The User can access the necessary contact details to get in touch with a specific recycling facility.
The User can opt-in to receive alerts about recycling events relevant to their location.
The User will get real-time alerts when new special waste drop-off locations are announced.
The User can mark specific facilities for quick access in the future.
The User can log their recycling efforts to keep a personal history.
The User can provide comments, suggestions, or report issues through a dedicated form.
The User can directly communicate with administrators for inquiries.
The Administrator can input all necessary details for a new facility to be listed on the platform.
The Administrator can modify any detail of an already listed facility to keep it current.
The Administrator can remove facilities that are no longer operational or relevant.
The Administrator can access a centralized view of all user communications.
The Administrator can assign types to feedback for better organization and prioritization.
The Administrator can communicate back to the user regarding their submission.
The Administrator ensures that data exchanged between the application and servers is secure from interception.
The Administrator can define permissions for various roles (e.g., User, Facility Representative, Administrator, Superuser) to restrict data access.
The Administrator can review a record of who accessed or changed data and when, for security and compliance purposes.
The Administrator can initiate communication with a facility to request or confirm information updates.
The Administrator can review and decide on changes proposed by facility staff.
The Facility Representative can log in to a specific interface to manage their facility's information.
The Facility Representative can update the opening and closing times for their facility.
The Facility Representative can modify the types of materials their facility accepts.
The Facility Representative can report problems or concerns directly to the administrators.
The Facility Representative gets an acknowledgment that their reported issue has been received.
The Superuser can make immediate changes to facility data, bypassing the standard approval workflow.
The Superuser can directly implement changes, even if a Facility Representative has submitted a conflicting update.
The Superuser can view all questions submitted by users that require a response.
The Superuser can compose and send an answer to a user's specific inquiry.
The Superuser can update the status of an inquiry to indicate it has been addressed.
